g5O1YSxp-RSI-Exact-Divergence-Strategy-E.idea: Regular RSI(14) divergence between successive 5/5 RSI pivots touching 30/70, entered only with the daily EMA200 trend; opposite divergence closes the trade.

entries.condition: Bullish divergence (price lower low, RSI higher low, one pivot at or below 30) and prior daily close above daily EMA200.
Bearish divergence (price higher high, RSI lower high, one pivot at or above 70) and prior daily close below daily EMA200.
buySignal = bullDiv and htfTrendUp, plotted on the signal bar.
sellSignal = bearDiv and htfTrendDown, plotted on the signal bar.

exit.how: Opposite divergence (no HTF filter) closes the position; an opposite filtered entry reverses it.

timing.note: RSI pivots confirm 5 bars late; daily series use [1] with lookahead_off; div shapes are drawn 5 bars back.

Bj46W5Gs-liquidity-sweep-divergence-smt..idea: SMT divergence: chart asset wicks through its previous 2/2 swing high/low and closes back while a second asset (default BINANCE:BTCUSDT) fails to break its own.

entries.condition: Low sweeps previous swing low by over 0.2 ATR, close back above, swings synced, second asset makes no lower low.
High sweeps previous swing high by over 0.2 ATR, close back below, swings synced, second asset makes no higher high.

timing.note: Same-timeframe request.security on another symbol, default lookahead off; pivots confirm 2 bars late.

LIBFEE2F-Center-of-Gravity-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Ehlers Center of Gravity: negated position-weighted centroid of the last 10 hl2 values; crossing its own one-bar delay marks cycle troughs and crests.

entries.condition: CG crosses above its one-bar-delayed copy, i.e. the oscillator turns up.
CG crosses below its one-bar-delayed copy, i.e. the oscillator turns down.

exit.how: none explicit; the opposite cross is the next cue.

timing.note: Closed-bar; a cross of cg over cg[1] is just a slope change, so it fires on every turn.

LIB91008-NRTR-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Nicolas Kopyrkin's trailing reverse: a ratcheting trailing line (percent or ATR offset from trend extreme) flips the state when close crosses it; each flip is a stop-and-reverse signal.

entries.condition: State was down and source closes above the trailing line (flipBullish).
State was up and source closes below the trailing line (flipBearish).
Same flipBullish event drawn as a circle at the trailing line; needs Reversal Markers on (default true).
Same flipBearish event drawn as a circle at the trailing line.

stop.how: Trailing line (percent or ATR from trend extreme) is the stop; crossing it reverses the state.
stop.name: NRTR

exit.how: Stop-and-reverse: the opposite reversal flip closes the position.

timing.note: Flip decided on closed source (close); trailing line only ratchets. No pivots, no security.

LIB231AF-Volume-weighted-MACD-LuxAlgo.pi.idea: MACD built from volume-weighted moving averages (fast minus slow VWMA) with a signal line and histogram; alerts on signal cross, zero cross and histogram turns.

entries.condition: VW-MACD line crosses above its signal line.
VW-MACD line crosses below its signal line.
VW-MACD crosses above zero (fast VWMA above slow VWMA).
VW-MACD crosses below zero.

exit.how: Opposite signal cross implied; no explicit exit marker.

timing.note: Closed-bar crossovers; volume-weighted averages need real volume, falls back to simple mean if none.

LIB5DA68-VWAP-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Anchored VWAP (session, week or month) with standard-deviation or percent bands; line coloured by price side. Cross alerts are informational.

timing.note: Daily/week/month anchor via timeframe.change; closed-bar cross. VWAP hidden on 1D+.

iwEyBE2d-Moving-Average-Trend-Sniper-Cha.idea: Adaptive smoothed moving average with ATR glow band; line colour flips blue/orange when close crosses it. Colour only, no markers or alerts.

timing.note: Computed from closed bars only; nothing is signalled.

tGI9kmoO-Phase-Regression-Oscillator-Lux.idea: Least-squares fit of a sine/cosine to the last N closes; plots sine of the fitted phase as an oscillator with overbought/oversold lines. No alerts.

timing.note: Computed from closed bars only; nothing is signalled.

fgbYXSfz-Rising-Falling-Window-Signals-L.idea: Detects rising and falling windows (price gaps between bars) as support/resistance zones and labels an arrow when a later candle tests the zone with a rejection pattern.

entries.condition: Candle tests a rising-window (gap-up) zone top with engulfing, regular or wick rejection (default Engulfing).
Candle tests a falling-window (gap-down) zone bottom with bearish engulfing, regular or wick rejection.

stop.how: Zone edge is implicit invalidation (close beyond zone deletes it); not output.

timing.note: Labels drawn on the bar that confirms the test; zones from completed bars. Label y sits at zone edge, not at price.

4v1ExKvr-VWAP-Volume-Profile-BigBeluga.p.idea: Builds a volume profile along VWAP direction (up-VWAP volume positive, down negative) with +/-VWAP points of control; VWAP and candles coloured by VWAP slope.

timing.note: Drawn on last bar only; uses historical bars for profile.

Zq6iMAjj-Hullinger-Percentile-Oscillator.idea: Percentile position of price inside HMA-centred bands, smoothed. Swing mode trades smoothed-line turns; Contrarian mode trades band-edge crossbacks (weak and strong reversals).

entries.condition: Smoothed oscillator crosses above its value two bars earlier (turns up).
Smoothed oscillator crosses below its value two bars earlier (turns down).
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses up through the outer lower band.
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses down through the outer upper band.
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses up through 0 (inner lower band).
Contrarian mode only: oscillator crosses down through 100.

exit.how: Opposite swing signal implied; no exit marker.

timing.note: Signals use closed-bar crosses; divergence plots use offset -1 but are not alerted.

caro9zQE-MVRV-Z-Score-AlgoAlpha.pine.idea: Bitcoin on-chain MVRV z-score (daily, BTC_MVRV feed) shown as Heiken Ashi candles with HMA; flags band crossings and divergences. Same BTC value is applied to whatever symbol is charted.

entries.condition: Price lower low while HA z-score higher low at a confirmed pivot low (1 bar lag).
Price higher high while HA z-score lower high at a confirmed pivot high.
HA z-score crosses up through -4 (oversold edge).
HA z-score crosses up through +4 (overbought edge).
HA z-score crosses up through -2.32.
HA z-score crosses up through +2.32.

timing.note: Daily on-chain series via security (lookahead off); signals change once per day and hold across intraday bars.

mE6LGQLx-Curved-Price-Channels-Zeiierman.idea: Curved ratcheting upper/lower bands (ATR-scaled, widening with bars since last extreme) and their average as a trendline; shows a trend-strength read-out. No alerts.

timing.note: Computed from closed bars only; nothing is signalled.

7zdMTKnr-Liquidity-Levels-Sweeps-Grabs-F.idea: ICT liquidity tool: previous day and week highs/lows; flags sweeps (pierce then close back through, over bars) and grabs (single wick rejection) as stop-run reversals.

entries.condition: Prior day/week low pierced earlier, now close back above it.
Prior day/week high pierced earlier, now close back below it.
One candle wicks below level with wick >= body and closes back above.
One candle wicks above level with wick >= body and closes back below.
Same sweep event as the low-sweep alert, triangle up below bar.
Same high-sweep event, triangle down above bar.
Same low grab event, diamond below bar.
Same high grab event, diamond above bar.

stop.how: None output; wick extreme beyond the level is the natural stop.

timing.note: Prior day/week levels use [1] with lookahead_on, so fixed and safe; sweep can complete many bars after the pierce.

4XMv68nQ-Gova-s-WSA-Screener.pine.idea: Weinstein stage analysis on a chosen timeframe (default weekly, 30-bar MA): classifies stage 1 to 4 and offers alerts when a stage starts. Built as a screener.

timing.note: Security on Analysis Timeframe with lookahead off and previous confirmed bar; stage known at close.

LIBF15DB-Premier-Stochastic-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Leibfarth's Premier Stochastic: double-smoothed centred stochastic squashed to +/-1. Crosses of +/-0.2 mark directional shifts; crosses back inside +/-0.9 mark fading extremes.

entries.condition: Oscillator crosses back up through -0.9, downside momentum fading.
Oscillator crosses back down through +0.9, upside momentum fading.
Oscillator crosses up through +0.2 (leaves neutral band).
Oscillator crosses down through -0.2.

exit.how: Opposite shift or fade implied; no exit marker.

timing.note: Closed-bar crossovers on a lagging double EMA; no pivots or security.

5QtH3KYD-Multi-Layer-Volume-Profile-BigB.idea: Four nested volume profiles (300, 150, 75, 37 bars) with point of control, total and delta volume labels, drawn on the last bar. No alerts.

timing.note: Drawn on last bar only.

MBStXuFk-Jurik-Price-Bands-and-Range-Box.idea: Jurik-smoothed price with wide ATR-based macro bands plus a 200-bar range box and mid line; dashboard shows up/down trend. No alerts.

timing.note: Range box and dashboard drawn on last bar only.

gqtSuLQt-Adaptive-Resonance-Oscillator-A.idea: RSI whose period adapts to a Hilbert-transform cycle estimate, HMA-smoothed. Marks turns of the line, stronger turns out of the 20/80 extremes, and regular divergences.

Smoothed RSI turns down while the prior value was above 80.
Price lower low with higher RSI low at a pivot low confirmed 1 bar later.
Price higher high with lower RSI high at a pivot high confirmed 1 bar later.
Smoothed RSI turns up outside the 20/80 extremes (diamond).
Smoothed RSI turns down outside the 20/80 extremes.

exit.how: Opposite turn signal implied; no exit marker.

timing.note: Turn signals on closed bars; divergence pivots confirm 1 bar late (plot offset is visual only).

x3KNfmR3-RSI-Momentum-Divergence-Zones-C.idea: RSI of 10-bar momentum with pivot divergence: price lower low with RSI higher low is bullish, price higher high with RSI lower high is bearish; draws zone lines at the pivot.

RSI pivot high (5/5) confirmed, RSI lower than prior pivot within 5-50 bars, and price high higher than prior pivot high

Same bearish divergence as Bearish Label, drawn on the price chart

eJDO07bj-Hann-Window-FIR-Filter-Ribbon-B.idea: Six Hann-window FIR moving averages form a colour-graded ribbon; a cross of the first two lines draws support or resistance zones. No alerts or markers.

3gpERF3o-RSI-Prediction-by-Range-Segment.idea: RSI with history of 100-bar RSI paths grouped by starting RSI segment; on the last bar projects the average path forward as a polyline coloured by direction.

eR9y7zmm-Log-Regression-Oscillator-Chann.idea: Log-regression channel over 150 bars (stdev bands) with RSI/MFI/Stochastic oscillator redrawn inside the channel as a polyline. Visual overbought/oversold context only.

zGK0XvCC-Smooth-Cloud-BigBeluga.pine.idea: Three Ehlers SuperSmoother lines (60, 40, 20 bars); fast line crossing the slowest gives an up or down arrow signal, drawn 2 ATR(200) from the fast line.

ta.crossunder(source, JMA)

JMA slope turns from >=0 to <0

Same crossDown as Bearish Price Cross, drawn only when showSignalsInput is true (default false)

2DdGznIR-Auto-Trend-Drawing-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Simplifies the last 300 closes (ATR-normalised Ramer-Douglas-Peucker) into anchor points and draws a Catmull-Rom spline polyline on the last bar. Pure drawing.

olH8ZDWi-Candle-Body-Support-Resistance-.idea: Big candles (body above 2 ATR) set support or resistance lines at half their body; dots mark retests that hold. Lines are removed when closed through.

1TNKGfkP-Phoenix-Ascending-2-6.pine.idea: Oscillator averaging TCI, money-flow RSI and RSI (WaveTrend-style) with a red signal line, LSMA, energy histogram and pressure dots beyond 20/80. No markers.

close < LSMA - 1.5*ATR(14) and LSMA falling

e6zVkDBB-Price-Point-Volume-Oscillator-L.idea: Estimates buy/sell volume traded at the current price over the last 100 bars (by close position in each bar) and plots delta histogram and dashboard. No signals.

Same event as the alertcondition, plotchar triangle above bar

i8IAjLKw-Adaptive-Volume-Profile-v1-5.pi.idea: Builds a volume profile over the last N chart bars from lower-timeframe data and draws boxes with per-row volume and a coverage table on the last bar.

PwTdSQ3F-Volume-Range-Profile-with-Fair-.idea: Builds volume histograms in the top and bottom 30% of the 100-bar range, shows buy/sell volume totals and a drifting fair-value line from the upper-zone POC average.

LIBE1123-TPO-Profile-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Builds daily TPO letter profiles from 30-minute periods with POC, value area and initial balance; alerts on range extension beyond the initial balance and on crosses of prior-session levels.

First time in the session low drops below the initial-balance low, after the opening periods are complete.

gHHRpuHC-Change-in-State-of-Delivery-CIS.idea: ICT change in state of delivery: close beyond the open of the last opposite-colour candle run marks a trend flip (Classic), or after a swing liquidity sweep (Liquidity Sweep mode). Labels only, no alerts.

Classic: close below the open of the last bullish candle run, within max validity; label colour bearish, text has no side.

Liquidity Sweep mode only: bearish CISD after a swing-high sweep, drawn at the bar high.

wIIzTurg.pine.idea: Marks candles in three one-hour sessions (Asia, Europe, America, Shanghai time) with boxes and labels classifying volume behavior, liquidity and ATR state; a status table. Information only.

LIB2497C-Autocorrelation-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Rolling autocorrelation of returns (200-bar window, lag 1) with significance bands; flags momentum-friendly or mean-reversion-friendly regimes plus a correlogram. A regime reading, not a signal.

timing.note: Rolling window of closed-bar returns; correlogram drawn on last bar only.

LIBB5A8B-January-Effect-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Measures January returns against other months and grades the January barometer (January direction vs the rest of the year). Statistics dashboard, no trade setup.

LIB71CC6-Momentum-Expansion-vs-Contracti.idea: Reads an oscillator (default MACD histogram) as expansion or contraction phases and compares successive momentum peaks and troughs. A momentum-shape lens, not a trade trigger.

timing.note: Swing alerts lag by the 5-bar pivot length; phase alerts use current-bar oscillator values.

E4w7VtBS-Retest-Break-Setup-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: After a close breaks a swing high or low, counts K retests that hold the broken level, then prints a Break label when price closes beyond the retest extreme within N bars.

After K retests of a broken swing low, close drops below the lowest low since the break within N bars.

gHKRvMlB-Curved-Trend-Channels-Zeiierman.idea: Draws a step-based trend line with volatility bands (regular or curved mode) and optional candle colouring from line direction. Pure visualization; no alerts or markers.

timing.note: No request.security, no pivots; direction is not exposed as a marker.

RJqOaPRR-BTC-Power-Law-Ladder-Point-in-T.idea: Divides BTC price by a power-law trend line refit each January and tracks valuation rungs with a de-risk (above 2.5x) and restore (below 1.6x) rule. Daily only; a risk instrument.

timing.note: State uses barstate.isconfirmed but only on daily bars; alertconditions are not gated by valid.

LIBB1F11-Bagging-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Bootstrap ensemble of 50 k-NN models on momentum, RSI and z-score features predicts the next 5-bar direction; the averaged prediction crossing zero flips bias.

entries.condition: Ensemble prediction crosses above zero (ta.crossover(ensembleValue, 0)).
Ensemble prediction crosses below zero (ta.crossunder(ensembleValue, 0)).

exit.how: Opposite zero-cross of the ensemble; no separate exit marker.

rtqVynGv-Fibonacci-Volume-Profiles-AlgoA.idea: Draws Fibonacci retracement levels between the latest swing pivots plus a volume profile of the leg. Drawing tool only; no alerts or signal markers.

isf58Fgf-Multi-Timeframe-Supertrend-Pro-.idea: Three Supertrends (chart, confirmation, weekly) vote; a signal prints when at least 2 agree on a new direction. Intended as a consensus trend-flip entry.

Consensus flips to bear: at least 2 of 3 Supertrends bearish and previous consensus was not bear.

Same consensus_flip_bear event.

All three Supertrends bearish after fewer than 3 on the prior bar.

↓ MTF ST Pro [algotim] | Primary ST turned BEARISH

LIB95447-Volume-adjusted-Time-LuxAlgo.pi.idea: Resamples price into volume-clock bars (a bar prints when a volume bucket fills) and draws them as candles. Alerts fire when a bucket prints, coloured by close vs open.

LIBFA520-Cointegration-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Engle-Granger pairs test of the chart symbol against a second symbol; fades spread z-score crossings beyond +/-2 while the spread tests stationary, exit when z returns to the mean.

Same event as Short Spread Entry, drawn only if Show Signal Markers is on (default off).

timing.note: request.security same timeframe, default lookahead off; SPX is closed on weekends so the second leg goes stale on crypto bars.

LIB7D34A-Unfinished-Auction-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Audits each completed session for unfinished highs and lows (no excess tail, stacked TPOs or closing-bell extreme), draws them as references price tends to revisit, and flags repair.

targets.how: Unfinished levels act as destinations but no target is emitted.

timing.note: Session audited on the first bar of the next session (timeframe.change); no request.security.

kjPMckBt-Bitcoin-Power-Law-Clock-LuxAlgo.idea: Draws Bitcoin's daily log price and a smoothed average as a 4-year-cycle spiral clock with halvings and a time-and-price table. Purely a visual cycle map.

1milyM6X-Liquidity-Absorption-Engine-Str.idea: Composite score from wick absorption, liquidity sweeps and flow; a smoothed score crossing 72 (or 28) opens one long or short plan with ATR stop, three ATR targets and a DCA level.

timing.note: Signals gated by barstate.isconfirmed; no request.security despite header comment about HTF.

LIB732E1-VWAP-Pinch-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Two VWAPs anchored at the latest swing high and low converge; when price compresses between them and then closes beyond for several bars, that is a directional escape, with retests of the surviving VWAP.

Pinch active and 2 consecutive closes below the lower VWAP.

Triangle over bar on the same bar as the bearish escape alert.

After bearish resolution, high first touches the high-anchored VWAP from below.

LIB8C009-Execution-Algo-Footprints-LuxAl.idea: Scores intrabar slice uniformity, one-sided delta, pullback persistence and volume participation to flag a working buy or sell execution program; confirmed after 60 minutes and 1 ATR of span.

Footprint starts or flips: score at least 50 with net sell delta. Alert text calls it tentative.

LIBB04E8-Three-Black-Crows-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Detects three long dark candles opening inside prior bodies and closing near lows after an advance, a bearish reversal; variants add identical opens and a swing-low break, plus bounce levels.

Within 20 bars of a signal, high reaches the first crow's open: deeper bounce to sell into.

LIBCD36B-Absorption-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Tracks swing-based support and resistance zones that reject heavy-volume approaches on narrow or stalled bars; flags absorption after enough tests, confirms on a 1 ATR departure and refutes on a decisive break.

Qualified resistance zone and close more than 1 ATR below the zone bottom (level held).

zJ4hOaOp-Half-Cup-LuxAlgo.pine.idea: Draws a quarter-circle half cup between the last pivot high and a new pivot low (and the inverse) with projected channel lines, and marks dots where price closes through those channels.

CDfsfyDO-Three-Session-Volume-Profile.pi.idea: Builds Asia, London and New York session volume profiles with POC, value area and optional session VWAP bands, drawn as polylines and lines for level reference.

E31jKiTS.author: WillyAlgoTrader
E31jKiTS.summary: Structural anchors define a volume-weighted leg. The 12 November v1.2.1 update requires close confirmation for retests by default and allows a three-bar reclaim window.

Priority: the enabled VM base still records September source. Import November as a separate version, verify new alerts and compare prospectively. Preserve the intentionally separate HL/LH-pivot variant and existing evidence.

hkKioUnL.author: WillyAlgoTrader

Warmup and range maturity intentionally delay signals. v2.4 limits cumulative sweep depth, resets opposite breaches and freezes relevant geometry. Keep cancellation and expiry distinct from entries. Preserve its tick and gap handling, but recalculate fees and fills independently; this is not a fully sized multi-partial exchange strategy.

ngb1s23R.author: WillyAlgoTrader
ngb1s23R.summary: STRAT candle sequences arm a trigger with expiry; independent trap setups also exist. Regime, volume and risk checks qualify the actual trade.
ngb1s23R.requirements: Structural stop, R targets and break-even. Bare pattern alerts do not necessarily mean a new position opened. Optional Full Timeframe Continuity uses forming HTF information; it is off by default and changes replay parity when enabled. Keep setup and executed model-entry events separate. Document the FTC setting in the evidence identity. Do not remove the neutral-regime filter merely to increase counts; test that alternative independently.

eQPdoeM6.author: WillyAlgoTrader
eQPdoeM6.summary: CHoCH and confirmed pivots build an impulse and corrective-wave interpretation with projected levels.
eQPdoeM6.requirements: Wave invalidation and projection updates describe a pattern; they are not an executable position lifecycle. Unfinished wave points can move. Confirmed pivots arrive after their right-hand lookback, even if labels appear earlier. Use as structure context. Ignore ended/invalidated patterns as entries. Any strategy built from these waves requires its own explicit trigger, stop, timing and evidence.

ZoccxbOB.author: WillyAlgoTrader
ZoccxbOB.summary: The public explanation describes a staged 1–2–3 reversal, an armed projection and a later confirmed trade.
ZoccxbOB.requirements: Three targets and stepwise stop management; later release notes describe a fuller exit-alert lifecycle. An armed zone can change before entry. The author’s chart results omit exchange frictions and use optimistic target ordering. Public explanation reviewed; source access is unavailable. The VM marks it removed. Do not claim code parity or activate from chart screenshots.

73fIFFEV.requirements: Wick/ATR protection with three targets, break-even and reversal handling. Entries confirm at bar close and HTF context is closed-bar based. Choppy markets can still produce repeated flips. Candidate for a distinct trend-following test. Retain the author’s trigger and geometry; compare native exits against current engine exits using identical causal fills, not dashboard hit rates.

Z4DiNsKb.requirements: No autonomous intraday entry, stop or exchange-position lifecycle. Designed around daily/weekly Bitcoin history and manually chosen fit points. Extrapolation is not a forecast probability. Keep on research charts. Exclude from scalping signal quotas and from the count of scanners expected to open trades.

cdnBBG0A.author: WillyAlgoTrader
cdnBBG0A.summary: An ATR-band trend change establishes direction; a touch arms a retest, then reclaim and directional close must qualify within a limited window. Quality combines several factors.
cdnBBG0A.requirements: Wick or ATR stop, R targets and break-even; opposite signals close the existing side. The author’s model gives stop priority. Warmup, retest expiry and the internal active trade intentionally suppress repeats. HTF alignment can be a score contribution rather than a universal hard gate. The enabled ATR-maker variant is deliberate. Local fixtures confirm legacy reversal text closes the wrong side; reader 2 fixes it. Compare as a versioned variant, preserving margin, evidence and execution policy.

qBUHu6aW.author: WillyAlgoTrader

October v1.4 rejects double-sided sweeps, invalidates pending setups when the wick is retaken, and blocks wrong-side stops. The newer publication already has a separate upstream entry on the VM. Keep it separate from the June base. Test cancellation and actual entries; TP1 hit rate does not measure net profitability.

The installed long-label allow-list is an intentional measured reading. A two-sided author-native version needs a separate comparison, not an overwrite. Stop distance percent is distinct from account dollar risk.

RjkDXQnZ.summary: An EMA/ATR trail flips; regime, quality and filters decide the new entry. v1.4 adds context such as nearby obstacles and extension.

H0DfZXtR.summary: Confirmed pivots, candle volume and subsequent reactions build clustered levels. Qualified breakouts or timed retests generate entries.

UWC4kQ9O.author: WillyAlgoTrader

Management alert toggles differ from entry toggles; some target/break-even messages are off by default. Verify every required alert toggle and bind exit/update events to the correct trade. DRgzod5I.author: WillyAlgoTrader

findings.evidence: Raw maxNorm and maxBal are var declarations inside last-bar processing and only increase, while each profile is rebuilt from fresh arrays. findings.evidence: getCandle uses unshifted close/open and request.security lookahead_on; volume in getMTF is also unshifted. Non-default higher-timeframe historical detection can receive future HTF completion, beyond merely live repaint.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

h4xuU8kN.author: Zeiierman

PwTdSQ3F.author: Zeiierman

XOHrX8Wm.author: Zeiierman

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.marker: Stoch Basis / Upper and Lower Bands
findings.evidence: Raw basis=ma(close,bandLength,bandType); dev=ATR*(1+(50-abs(stochK-50))/100). This does not mathematically enforce the claimed price/basis equivalence to K/50 or price/band equivalence to OB/OS thresholds.
findings.action: Describe stochastic-influenced volatility bands, not an exact oscillator-to-price conversion.

5jS51RsP.author: Zeiierman

findings.evidence: getMTF returns current close/high/low/volume and request.security uses lookahead_on. Thus the contract safe label applies only to default chart timeframe, not arbitrary HTF selection.
findings.action: Restrict timing claims to verified configuration and separately test completed-HTF semantics.

findings.evidence: getCandle computes max(close,open)-min(close,open), which is body magnitude rather than wick length.
findings.action: Document body-based impulse filtering rather than the author description's wick-size test.

ZsWZRg62.author: Zeiierman

findings.evidence: confirmedUptrend uses trendDown>=trending and creates downward Trend Up; confirmedDowntrend uses trendUp>=trending and creates upward Trend Dn. No default specs override exists. Generic direction names invert these intended sides.

findings.evidence: Author explicitly says close long when price crosses below dynamic MA and short above. Source plots Dynamic MA but emits no such exit event; prior contract exit.has=false omits this author requirement.

QkHAjRH4.author: Zeiierman

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

EFGQPt1E.author: Zeiierman

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

SdMSDRLI.author: Zeiierman

findings.evidence: Raw dynamic_length=smoothing_length+int(abs(scaled_volatility)*2), then alpha=2/(length+1). Greater absolute deviation therefore lengthens smoothing and reduces alpha rather than shortening it.
findings.action: Correct smoothing description to actual behavior; do not infer greater responsiveness during extreme deviations.

mE6LGQLx.author: Zeiierman

findings.action: Keep manual strategy choices separate; require explicit tested entry, structural protection and target support before author-native execution.

rbNId5zr.author: Zeiierman
rbNId5zr.summary: Tracks confirmed pivots and CHoCH/SMS/BMS states across selectable symbols, with premium/discount/midrange context and batched ticker-qualified alerts. Author offers pullback, structural reversal and reaction-based examples.
rbNId5zr.requirements: Alerts can concern other symbols and must not open the chart symbol blindly. Preserve ticker identity and pivot availability; the default enables five symbols among twenty configurable inputs. Labels and premium/discount occupancy remain context without native stops or exits.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Prior contract says five hard-coded stocks, but raw uses input.symbol across twenty slots with five enabled by default. Each alert prefixes the originating ticker and the final output joins them.
findings.action: Document configurable multi-symbol scope and prohibit collapsing a batched external-symbol alert into a chart-symbol entry.

LjuoM8aq.author: Zeiierman
LjuoM8aq.summary: Plots hourly/four-hour opens, an hourly average, extremes and projected HTF candles. Optional retest triangles mark zone/line revisits with a per-hour limit and optional volume filter. Author additionally proposes sweep and equal-level examples.
LjuoM8aq.requirements: Intended chart resolution is one or five minutes. Retests default off; enabling them is a strategy configuration choice. Untitled triangle direction matters. Unshifted lookahead-on HTF OHLC feeds drawings, while prior-close requests are shifted; do not indiscriminately treat drawing leakage as retest leakage. No native stop or exit rules exist.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

S0c57GlJ.author: Zeiierman
S0c57GlJ.summary: Reads TradingView analyst target and recommendation fields, draws highest/lowest targets and an average/median range, and summarizes buy/hold/sell counts.
S0c57GlJ.requirements: These are external analyst opinions for supported stocks, not native technical entries, bot take-profits or performance evidence. Missing symbol fields remain unavailable; last-bar displays cannot serve as point-in-time historical backtest signals. No trade lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

i7W5HFQh.author: Zeiierman
i7W5HFQh.summary: Calculates rolling volume-weighted price, applies a Fourier transform component and plots volatility/deviation bands. Author suggests lower-band entries in uptrends, upper-band entries in downtrends and optional opposite-band or harmonic-divergence exits.
i7W5HFQh.requirements: The source exports reference plots, not explicit entry, divergence or exit events. Trend qualification, exact touch and exit choices require a separately specified strategy; do not claim native management from the band drawings. The Fourier-transformed series is visually hidden by default.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

MDtuDzTh.author: Zeiierman
MDtuDzTh.summary: Combines close minus an EMA of true range with lookback price displacement, then smooths the average and surrounds it with normal/expanded Bollinger bands. Author describes trend, extension, breakout, reversion and divergence uses.
MDtuDzTh.requirements: Those uses can imply opposing directions; no single band event is a complete entry rule. Source subtracts a volatility series rather than the closing-price average described in prose. This original oscillator emits plots/fills only; the later Overlay publication's alert logic must not be assumed here.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Description says closing price minus a moving average of closes adjusted for volatility. Raw volAdjPrice is EMA(trueRange), and priceDelta=close-volAdjPrice, blended with close-close[length].
findings.action: Document the literal implemented arithmetic; keep original plot-only and later overlay-alert variants distinct.

p5gGWHl5.author: Zeiierman
p5gGWHl5.summary: Swing recency or chosen bias selects direction; automatic median swing distance, pivot or percentage methods define trailing boundaries. A live risk/reward box and required break-even win rate use current close as a hypothetical entry. May 2026 updates Pine version.
p5gGWHl5.requirements: Break-even curve is a required win-rate relationship, not an instruction to amend a real stop to entry. Opposite boundary supplies hypothetical reward, not a filled target. Both plots share TSL title, requiring side-aware disambiguation. Native protective trailing requires engine support; no actual position is tracked.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Two TSL plots expose longtsl and shorttsl. Risk/reward and minimum win rate are recomputed from current close on last bar; there is no tracked fill or break-even-stop amendment.
findings.action: Keep hypothetical risk planning separate from execution and profitability evidence; require explicit side/plot selection and tested stop management for any native variant.

znmwwlYD.author: Zeiierman
znmwwlYD.summary: Modified ATR/supertrend and HMA-based smoothing produce dynamic support/resistance and a trailing cloud. Color changes describe direction; 2024 update fixes color and April 2026 update describes smoother filtering without precise parameters.
znmwwlYD.requirements: The author presents trend and dynamic support/resistance interpretation, not executable stop amendments or exits. Source Smart Trailing is a plot and deliberately gaps at direction changes. Prior stop/exit claims are reference interpretations, not a supported native lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Source plots trailing value only when direction persists across consecutive bars and emits no exit event. Author does not specify the exact position-close rule inferred by exit.has=true.
findings.action: Describe trailing reference only; any price-cross/flip exit or stop order requires an explicit separately tested policy.

ZSyG0zv6.author: Zeiierman
ZSyG0zv6.role: Trade setup / adaptive MA filtered signals
ZSyG0zv6.summary: Efficiency ratio controls Kaufman-style smoothing. Gamma-adjusted prior-AMA crossings, cooldown and optional candle-trend agreement generate Buy/Sell events. Trend-change alerts and AMA candles provide context; updates note color and performance changes.
ZSyG0zv6.requirements: Use actual Buy/Sell signals, not every Positive/Negative Trend change. Gamma changes trend/reversal behavior. UI shapes duplicate the same events and must not create extra entries; candle-trend filtering is optional. Marker offsets are cosmetic, not protective levels. No native stops, targets or exits exist.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.marker: UI - Buy Signal / UI - Sell Signal
findings.evidence: Prior contract lists these as entries, but raw UI shapes have the same displaySignal conditions as the main Buy/Sell shapes and only different size/transparency.
findings.action: Treat UI variants as duplicate visualization and emit one entry event per substantive signal.

aaPsyqft.author: Zeiierman
aaPsyqft.summary: Visible-range extremes anchor a percentage grid, fan, curves and angles; reverse/extend settings alter the drawing. Author proposes discretionary support/resistance and forecast interpretation.
aaPsyqft.requirements: The viewport changes anchors, so drawings are not fixed historical signal evidence. Forecast geometry is not validated prediction. Raw breakout alerts compare price against horizontal bar-coordinate values instead of price levels, so their advertised breakout meaning is unsupported.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: x0 is selected from high/low bar locations and x stores interpolated integer horizontal coordinates. Alert expressions compare low/high with x0 and x.get(i), mixing price with bar index instead of y-levels.
findings.action: Do not use these alerts as price-level breakouts. Any correction must be an independently tested source variant with viewport dependence resolved.

6Io0v2PL.author: Zeiierman
6Io0v2PL.summary: On daily bars, simulates calendar-day purchases using initial capital, monthly contributions and integer shares, then compares shares, cost and transaction counts with a randomized monthly selection.
6Io0v2PL.requirements: This is retrospective analysis, not entry signals or future evidence. The random comparator is nonreproducible without a fixed seed. Source price storage is not cleared monthly and writes the new month's first open before settling prior data, so missing-day and period-boundary handling need validation before using rankings.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: days column 3 persists across months without a reset; days.set(dayofmonth-1,3,open) runs before month-change processing. Thus a prior-month simulation can mix the new month's first open and stale prices for nontrading dates.
findings.action: Do not treat best-day or random-comparator tables as reliable evidence until calendar state and contribution handling are independently tested.

mqCV52bc.author: Zeiierman
mqCV52bc.summary: Aggregates open-to-close daily returns by calendar day/weekday and period returns by week/month. Tables show historical averages and bullish/bearish frequency context for optional seasonal analysis.
mqCV52bc.requirements: Requires daily timeframe and raises an error otherwise. The label Edge is a retrospective statistic, not an approved bot edge, causal effect or prospective win probability. Period sample size and calendar handling matter; no executable entries, risk or lifecycle rules are supplied.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

78AVOLmR.author: Zeiierman
78AVOLmR.summary: Builds a user-timed opening high/low, maps smoothed rolling volume into a range-relative activity measure, and qualifies upward/downward close crossings with activity above its average and threshold. Updates mention performance and Pine v6.
78AVOLmR.requirements: Preserve timezone/session configuration. PMMV is rolling chart-bar volume, not an empirical same-minute-across-days profile. Shapes add cooldown and display gating; alerts use raw crossings. These are distinct readings. Break Dn is short semantically; default reader vocabulary and active overrides must be respected. No native stop/target/exit lifecycle exists.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: SignalUp/SignalDn apply conditionloop, while alertconditions directly use breakUp/breakDn. Author activity requirement is present in both, but alert frequency differs from displayed signals.
findings.action: Keep shape versus raw-alert behavior explicit and preserve measured reader identities; do not assume channel equivalence.

1cAMZFft.author: Zeiierman
1cAMZFft.summary: Confirmed pivot breaks combined with an intact opposing extreme create order-block/imbalance boxes and BOS annotations. The May 2026 update adds BOS levels. Author treats zones as possible revisit/confluence areas rather than literal no-trade gaps.
1cAMZFft.requirements: Respect symmetric pivot delay and backdated drawings. Source bullish condition retains a stored low at or below recent lows; bearish retains a stored high at or above recent highs, rather than requiring a new extreme on the breakout bar. BOS/zone creation has no defined entry, stop, target or exit.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw bullish locross is close crossing stored high while stored lo<=lowest(low,prd); bearish is mirrored. This validates an unbroken opposing extreme rather than a mandatory new lower low/higher high on the break.
findings.action: Describe exact stored-extreme test and keep inferred imbalance zones separate from executed entries.

bHD78pHs.author: Zeiierman
bHD78pHs.summary: Golden Swap seeks shallow countertrend liquidity sweeps followed by renewed prior momentum near reference levels. Filters select symmetry, baseline bounds and optional pin bars. Updates add alerts and merge nearby reference labels.
bHD78pHs.requirements: Use completed Long/Short events; preliminary marks are context. Reference-level confluence remains discretionary. Selected signal timeframe and chart-timeframe filters must be distinguished; no native stop or target.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Source fetches selectable tf OHLC at 175, indexes its expanded series at 177–178, but filters and final close comparison use chart bars. Prior contract incorrectly says all entry logic uses chart timeframe.
findings.action: Constrain default chart timeframe or implement and test explicit mixed-timeframe semantics before alternate-tf approval.

9FUcuda3.author: Zeiierman
9FUcuda3.summary: Bloom combines opposite-color engulfing, baseline close placement and matching extremes. Precision PinBar combines top/bottom-third bodies with baseline and symmetry. Author recommends support/resistance confluence; updates add alerts and merged labels.
9FUcuda3.requirements: Pattern direction is explicit, but reference-level proximity is manual. Preserve optional display controls separately from alerts. PinBar formula does not require a three-times tail in every case. No native lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Prose describes a long tail at least three times the body; raw 167–168 permits bullish/bearish body color instead via OR. Shared tailLen measures the lower tail even for bearish logic.
findings.action: Describe actual formula and avoid treating the prose wick criterion as implemented.

eETJcnc8.author: Zeiierman
eETJcnc8.summary: Daily equity dashboard aggregates dividend amounts, shares, custom payout months and historical growth, optionally estimating future distributions. No updates are published.
eETJcnc8.requirements: Dividend calendar and alerts are portfolio information, not entry signals. Separate estimates and manual amounts from actual announcements; daily FactSet availability and currency govern outputs.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Author presents Ex-Date versus Actual Payout day. Raw 395 simply assigns payout to the following month for non-Ex-Date; it does not request an actual payment date.
findings.action: Label this an approximate month shift; do not use it as an authoritative payout schedule or trading trigger.

O5tcQ17r.author: Zeiierman
O5tcQ17r.summary: Tracks open-versus-previous-close gaps in percentage buckets, counts fills and average elapsed bars, and draws active/all gaps. Author explains possible gap interpretations without prescribing entries; update says minor changes only.
O5tcQ17r.requirements: New Bull/Bear gap and fill alerts are descriptive. Filling requires reaching the previous close, not any partial move into the gap. Fill statistics are historical counts, not win rates.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Raw 113–115 and 140–142 require the far gap boundary (previous close), stricter than prose saying price moves back into gap area.
findings.action: Keep informational and define full-gap closure precisely; no automatic trade from direction words.

ZrEdJ42P.author: Zeiierman
ZrEdJ42P.summary: Adaptive trend and volatility bands describe direction, compression and possible extremes. Settings control responsiveness and scalping behavior; the only update adds a license.
ZrEdJ42P.requirements: Use slope and band width as context. No crossings are emitted as entries or exits. Band touches do not prescribe reversals.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Prose says weighted moving average of historical prices and two standard deviations; source 51–60 uses deviation of recursively stored trend, average(close,trend) or drift, and configurable multipliers.
findings.action: Document actual recursive calculation; do not substitute a conventional WMA or fixed two-sigma model.

VVBbYPt4.author: Zeiierman
VVBbYPt4.summary: User selects a historical time, entry price and direction; the tool draws curved ATR-based stop and reward zones. No updates.
VVBbYPt4.requirements: Manual Entry/TP/Stoploss labels are levels, not entry signals or executable orders. Native position management would require explicit engine integration and selected trade state.

findings.evidence: Source computes ATR(10) at lastconfirmedhistory 55–63, not at manually selected entry timestamp x. Reopening historical entry can produce present-volatility levels.
findings.action: Treat as current visual planning; do not claim historical stop parity or native lifecycle.

qSC6hZNa.author: Zeiierman
qSC6hZNa.summary: TrendSphere forms an adaptive trend with ATR, historical-return volatility or Bollinger-width bands. Author suggests price-side alignment with narrowing Bollinger bands as a discretionary setup. No updates.
qSC6hZNa.requirements: Preserve selected volatility method and scaling. Author buy/sell suggestions require explicit new conditions; current source only plots context, with no emitted entry or lifecycle.

reconciliation.scope: Relevant conditions and lifecycle branches; prior full-source study remains separate.

findings.evidence: Source 94–110 updates recursive trend and renders bands; it never emits the prose conjunction of price above/below trend and narrowing bands. trueTrend compares direction to two bars ago at104.
findings.action: Keep display context; any executable narrowing-band strategy is a separate tested specification.

HsO1bxqX.author: Zeiierman
HsO1bxqX.summary: Displays recent lower-timeframe candles alongside the chart, with range high/low/mid and a timeframe table. Author suggests manual microtrend and support/resistance analysis. No updates.
HsO1bxqX.requirements: Require genuine lower timeframe data and enough intrabars. Rendered candles and reference levels are context; no directional entry, stop trigger or exit is supplied.

LeeciZlD.author: Zeiierman
LeeciZlD.summary: Recursive standard-deviation trend and optional structure styling illustrate directional levels and possible continuation breaks. No updates.
LeeciZlD.requirements: Interpret future-trend wording as a projected contextual level, not a validated forecast. Price holding beyond the line is prose guidance, not an emitted signal or management rule.

findings.evidence: Source57–72 computes one recursive current-price trend plot; no separate structure-break entry, stop or target event exists.
findings.action: Keep context-only; require an explicit causal crossover/hold rule before strategy implementation.

tG4HXiE1.author: Zeiierman
tG4HXiE1.summary: Displays several higher-timeframe candles and their high/low/mid range beside the chart for manual trend and level analysis. No updates.
tG4HXiE1.requirements: HTF candle drawings are not entries. Developing OHLC and completed historical HTF data must be distinguished; do not backtest the displayed current HTF values as causal chart-bar information.

KkAOEljd.author: Zeiierman
KkAOEljd.summary: Fibonacci retracement state feeds selectable RSI, MACD or close-minus-retracement histogram views to assess trend and pullbacks. No updates.
KkAOEljd.requirements: Oscillator type and source transformation matter. Colors, zero lines and extremes are analysis context; author supplies no discrete entry or exit rules.

EhJK1FZL.author: Zeiierman
EhJK1FZL.summary: Fibonacci retracement trend, channel and structure drawings support discretionary trend and level analysis. Author asks for price-action confirmation near retracements; no updates.
EhJK1FZL.requirements: Arrows denote structural trend changes, not an explicitly prescribed trade/stop system. Full high below or low above retracement triggers transitions; drawings are backdated to swing midpoint and must be timestamped at detection.

PFFQXniH.author: Zeiierman

oByzEgAT.author: Zeiierman
oByzEgAT.summary: Volatility-scaled grid supplies a stepwise midpoint and support/resistance ranges. September2023 update adds selectable volatility calculations after a minor fix.

zgEx7k4v.author: Zeiierman

zgEx7k4v.requirements: No emitted entries or lifecycle. Treat classifier as contemporaneous historical similarity, not validated forecast. Preserve source data, MA type and neighborhood settings.

PZKNUpQx.summary: Consecutive regular or Heikin-Ashi-style candle counts and historical next-color frequencies provide higher-timeframe bias for separately chosen lower-timeframe entries. No updates.

30aLnPNh.author: Zeiierman

30aLnPNh.requirements: MA/average crosses are distinct from price crosses and prediction-background states. Prediction labels must not define trade direction without source verification. No author stop/target lifecycle.

CVsC5pw9.requirements: Use only contextual historical activity, not live liquidity or entries. Row geometry depends on first loaded candle; source input may be a derived indicator rather than traded price.

Native repeated exit-ID updates and submission-before-ratchet ordering must be retained. Author-advertised age-based opposite-RSI early exit is absent. Source percentage sizing is not authorization to alter paper risk.

dRQLmHat.author: BigBeluga
dRQLmHat.summary: Higher-timeframe session profiles assign each candle volume to its closing-price bin and smooth the result.
dRQLmHat.requirements: POC lines are context; cannot substitute for measured execution depth or tick-level volume profile.

wMcOiPoG.author: blitz_algo
wMcOiPoG.summary: Extreme estimated delta, a stalled body, swing extreme and rejection wick arm an absorption reversal. The default waits up to three bars for a confirming close; violating the extreme cancels it.
wMcOiPoG.requirements: The source spacing OR can bypass the required absorption test. Keep the existing quarantine until the expression and lower-timeframe data coverage are validated. Delta is a candle proxy, not exchange aggressor flow; source position sizing and costs are placeholders.

srh0K2hS.author: BigBeluga
srh0K2hS.summary: MA/ATR trend flips anchor volume profiles; rolling POC represents accepted price inside the active leg.
srh0K2hS.requirements: BULL/BEAR anchor labels are regime changes, not a complete entry/exit system; profile is candle allocation.

AO8IiV8S.author: BigBeluga
AO8IiV8S.summary: Composite RSI, SMA distance and candle-volume flow sentiment, with extreme-threshold signals.
AO8IiV8S.requirements: Sentiment extremes alone do not define an entry; preserve context-only treatment and do not describe the value as external sentiment.

oM444F7G.author: ChartPrime
oM444F7G.summary: SMA/ATR trend bands and aligned fair-value gaps guide discretionary pullback analysis. The author suggests rejection at unmitigated gaps, but the code does not emit a complete rejection-entry condition.
oM444F7G.requirements: Do not trade the bullish/bearish statistics label or gap creation as a confirmed entry. Volume boxes estimate candle-position shares. A causal rejection rule and explicit protection would be a new, separately evaluated strategy.

0gfYLkX9.author: BigBeluga
0gfYLkX9.summary: Confirmed pivot wick-through and return inside; bull trap means short, bear trap means long. Grade combines zone freshness and volume, not calibrated probability.
0gfYLkX9.requirements: Require explicit trap-side mapping and confirmation time; no author full exit model.

M0FCXfZC.author: WillyAlgoTrader
M0FCXfZC.summary: An HTF liquidity sweep must precede lower-timeframe displacement/CISD and a qualifying PD-array setup. A diamond marks order placement; the later buy/sell event marks the model entry.
M0FCXfZC.requirements: Structural protection and multiple targets; pending limits can expire, invalidate or be cancelled before filling. Targets reached before a limit fills can cancel it. Confirmed chart bars; forming-HTF sweeps are possible unless HTF-close waiting is selected. Pivot drawings precede the time their structure becomes known. Keep setup, order and fill distinct. The installed market-only variant deliberately chooses Market and Conservative intrabar assumptions; it is not the default limit strategy. Test its native geometry and lifecycle with actual fills.
